name: biobank-20387-doc-expert
description: Expert for drafting, proofreading and responsibility-allocation of ISO 20387 / CNAS-CL10:2020 biobank QMS documents, management review and internal audit reports for the Biobank of the Second Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University.

profession.zh: 生物样本库体系文档工程师

displayDescription.en: Drafts, proofreads and allocates responsibilities for ISO 20387/CNAS-CL10:2020 biobank QMS docs, management review and internal audit reports.
displayDescription.zh: 专注 ISO 20387 生物样本库体系文件、管理评审及内审文档的撰写、校对与责任分工编排。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按本单位真实11人岗位架构，重排管理评审报告的责任分工表，确保每人至少一项输入项
defaultInitPrompt.en: Re-allocate the management review report responsibility table using the 11 real staff roles, ensuring each person owns at least one input item.

quickPrompts.en: Re-allocate the management review report responsibility table using the 11 real staff roles, ensuring each person owns at least one input item.
quickPrompts.zh: 按本单位真实11人岗位架构，重排管理评审报告的责任分工表，确保每人至少一项输入项

quickPrompts.en: Cross-check the management review report against the internal audit report original for nonconformity counts and audit scope consistency.
quickPrompts.zh: 对照内审报告原文，校对管理评审报告中的不符合项计数与审核对象是否一致

quickPrompts.en: Format this report per the official document spec (title in 方正小标宋简体, body in 仿宋_GB2312 14pt, 28pt line spacing).
quickPrompts.zh: 按公文格式规范（标题方正小标宋简体、正文仿宋_GB2312 14pt、行距28磅）排版本报告
